source_facts.anchor: PrepareStrings loads kind-4 objects 1000, 1001, and 1800 into fd_50F6_046C, fd_50F6_0324, and fd_50F6_0368 respectively; LoadStringAnt consumes a skipped byte, a count, then byte-length-prefixed strings.
SetEditWinTitle composes SimAnt + fd_50F6_0368[15] + fd_50F6_0324[fd_50F6_0EAC], formats object 1 in window 0, and redraws it only when window 0 is open.
SetMapTitle formats object 0x0101 from fd_50F6_046C[fd_3D57_07C8], object 0x1901 from fd_50F6_046C[YardMode+9], and redraws map window 0x0100 preferentially, otherwise yard window 0x1900.
Map mode setters use the bounded source indices 0 through 8; yard mode setters use 0 through 3.
win_SetObjFormatStr formats the target object's format string into an object-associated text buffer; the selected title table strings are passed through as formatted text.

tables.source_use: map mode indices 0..8 and yard mode indices 9..12

resource_evidence.loader_contract: The test compares every parsed string and table boundary against the actual SHARED records. Strings are retained as resource bytes; the native model adds only a terminating NUL in its owned copy.

implementation.resolver_contract: Signature-compatible with PortableWindowRenderer.resolve_text. Resolves only object index 1 in window IDs 0, 0x0100, and 0x1900 using the current title projection. It does not use serialized title text or alter resource pointers.

coverage.redraw_routing_cases: edit open/closed; map priority; yard fallback; neither open
coverage.invalid_input_cases: out-of-range map mode rejected without replacing prior projection; missing required table in HCEGANT rejected
